metadata.question: Does Somalia show lower soil moisture in April 2019 compared to the average April conditions?

data.raw_code: To answer this question, I need to: 1. Compare soil moisture in April 2019 vs average April conditions for Somalia 2. Use soil moisture data - SMAP would be appropriate here 3. Define Somalia geometry 4. Calculate mean soil moisture for April 2019 and for average April conditions (maybe 2015-2020 excluding 2019) 5. Compare the two values For soil moisture, I'll use SMAP data which provides soil moisture measurements. The SMAP collection is 'NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007' which provides global soil moisture data. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
somalia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [40.98, 11.99], [51.41, 11.99], [51.41, -1.66], [40.98, -1.66], [40.98, 11.99]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition - SMAP Soil Moisture
# April 2019 data
april_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') \
    .filterDate('2019-04-01', '2019-04-30') \
    .filterBounds(somalia)

# Historical April data (2015-2020 excluding 2019)
historical_april = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2015, 2020, 'year')) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.neq('year', 2019)) \
    .filterBounds(somalia)

# Check collection sizes
april_2019_count = april_2019.size().getInfo()
historical_count = historical_april.size().getInfo()

print(f"April 2019 Images: {april_2019_count}")
print(f"Historical April Images: {historical_count}")

if april_2019_count == 0 or historical_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Calculate mean soil moisture for April 2019
    april_2019_mean = april_2019.select('sm_surface_mean').mean()
    
    # Calculate historical mean for April
    historical_mean = historical_april.select('sm_surface_mean').mean()
    
    # Get pixel counts to check for valid data
    count_2019 = april_2019_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=somalia,
        scale=36000,  # SMAP resolution is ~36km
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sm_surface_mean').getInfo()
    
    count_hist = historical_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=somalia,
        scale=36000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('sm_surface_mean').getInfo()
    
    print(f"2019 Valid Pixels: {count_2019}")
    print(f"Historical Valid Pixels: {count_hist}")
    
    if count_2019 == 0 or count_hist == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean values
        val_2019 = april_2019_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=somalia,
            scale=36000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sm_surface_mean').getInfo()
        
        val_hist = historical_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=somalia,
            scale=36000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sm_surface_mean').getInfo()
        
        print(f"April 2019 Soil Moisture: {val_2019:.4f}")
        print(f"Historical April Average: {val_hist:.4f}")
        
        if val_2019 is None or val_hist is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif val_2019 < val_hist:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
